question: Why does Bhairava commend the goddess for asking about a matter hard for gods to obtain?
premises: He states that he has been asked a question.
The matter asked about is hard for even the gods to obtain.
inference: Bhairava commends the goddess because she has asked about knowledge that is rare even among the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; I have been asked about something hard for even the gods to obtain.
